Welcome!

You are participating in an economic experiment. At the end of the experiment, you will be paid for your participation. You will receive a participation fee of {{ 1.30|cu }} and earn additional money while completing the experimental tasks.

Overview

The experiment consists of two parts, Part 1 and Part 2, and will last for around 15 minutes. Before the start of each part, you will receive instructions for that part.

In the experiment, you will be randomly and anonymously assigned to a group with 3 other players. You and 3 other players in your group will never learn the identity of each other.

Your payment in the experiment will depend on both your decisions and the decisions of the 3 other players in your group.

In the experiment, we will use currency called Taler. All payoffs during the experiment (excluding the participation fee) will be calculated in Talers and will be converted into GBP at the end of the experiment. The conversion rate between Taler and GBP:

1 Taler = 0.75 pennies.

In the experiment, you and 3 other players in your group will be assigned one of the 4 colors:

Player Yellow Player Red Player Green Player Blue

On the next page, you will find out your color and receive instructions for Part 1.
